app.name: NestZone
app.what_it_is: A shared app for everyone who lives under one roof: chores, shopping, plans, money, notes, house chat, and Nestie, a little plant or pet the household grows together.

concept.primary: A simple, chunky house silhouette with a rounded roof, sitting snugly in a soft woven nest. A small two-leaf sprout grows from the roof where a chimney would be.
concept.meaning: Home (the house) + together/shelter (the nest) + growing together (the sprout = Nestie).
alternatives: Two overlapping rounded rooftops forming one shape, with a sprout between them (shared home).
A rounded house whose doorway is a warm glowing arch, with a sprout as the chimney.

composition.subject_size: about 62% of the canvas width, optically centred (slightly above centre)
composition.silhouette: must read instantly as a house at 60x60 px; one bold shape, no thin lines, no text, no letters
composition.corners: do NOT draw the rounded-corner mask; iOS applies it
composition.safe_area: keep everything important inside the central 80% circle

style.rendering: modern iOS 26 / Liquid Glass app icon: soft dimensional glass and matte surfaces, gentle top-left light, subtle inner highlights, soft contact shadow, no harsh gloss, no photorealism
style.shapes: geometric, rounded, friendly; consistent stroke-free forms; 2-3 layers maximum (background, house+nest, sprout)
style.detail_level: minimal; nest texture suggested with 3-4 soft curved bands, not hundreds of twigs

color.background: deep violet to indigo vertical gradient (#5B21B6 at top to #312E81 at bottom), very subtle radial glow behind the house
color.house: warm off-white (#FAF7FF) with a faint lavender shadow side
color.door_or_window: one small warm amber glow (#FBBF24) suggesting someone is home
color.contrast: house must stand out strongly from the background in light mode, dark mode and greyscale

variants_needed.dark: same artwork on a near-black violet background (#1A1033 to #0B0718); house slightly dimmer, glow slightly stronger
variants_needed.tinted: single-colour version: pure white artwork on transparent background, same silhouette, for iOS tinted icons

avoid: rounded-square frame drawn into the image
more than 4 colours in the subject
output: 3 separate PNGs: light, dark, tinted (white on transparent). 1024x1024 each.
